signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 捕风寻踪
refinements.description: 装备者的[追加攻击]命中敌人并造成电属性伤害时，目标的防御力降低25%，持续5秒，同名被动效果之间不可叠加；该效果触发时，如果自身不是当前操作中的角色，则装备者获得1层[魂锁]，最多叠加3层，同一招式内最多触发一次；每层[魂锁]，可使装备者的冲击力提升4%，持续12秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间，[魂锁]层数叠满时，额外给装备者的冲击力提升8%。
refinements.descriptionEn: When the equipper's Aftershock hits an enemy, causing Electric DMG, the target's DEF is reduced by 25% for 5s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack. When this effect is triggered, if the equipper is not the active character, they gain 1 stack of Spirit Lock, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. This can trigger only once per use of a skill. Each stack of Spirit Lock increases the equipper's Impact by 4%, lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. At full stacks of Spirit Lock, the equipper's Impact increases by an additional 8%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：冷膛射击
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的射击，前三段造成物理伤害，第四段造成电属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：幽闪
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动突进斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：幽闪花葬
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动突进斩击，并在跃起后向地面追加一段强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式命中敌人时，「扳机」将进入[协战状态]，期间队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，即可触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]，无需消耗[绝意]值，且没有冷却时间的限制，持续8秒，可触发4次，重复进入[协战状态]时延长持续时间，并获得可触发次数；最多持续20秒，可触发10次。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：极魂罚
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
转身回旋并对前方敌人发动快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：冥河之引
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方连续发动强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：冥府挽歌
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式命中敌人时，「扳机」将进入[协战状态]，期间队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，即可触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]，无需消耗[绝意]值，且没有冷却时间的限制，持续12秒，可触发6次，重复进入[协战状态]时延长持续时间，并获得可触发次数；最多持续20秒，可触发10次。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：冷枪援护
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
转身回旋并对前方敌人发动快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：死线偏移
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：殛雷穿心
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，随后落地蓄力并追加一段强力射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 终结一击命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，通过这种方式发动的[快速支援]25秒内最多触发一次。
facts.textEn: When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. A Quick Assist can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.

facts.text: 「扳机」发动[追加攻击]命中敌人时，目标的失衡易伤倍率提升35%，持续5秒，通过这种途径施加的失衡易伤倍率提升效果，在目标未进入失衡状态时亦可生效。
facts.textEn: When Trigger's Aftershock hits an enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35% for 5s. This Stun DMG Multiplier increase will apply even if the target isn't stunned.

cinema.name: 精准感知
cinema.description: 通过[核心被动：破隙幽瞳]施加的失衡易伤倍率额外提升20%；发动[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]时，触发的冷却时间降低至2秒；在[狙击姿态]下发动连续射击或蓄力反击命中敌人时，获得的[绝意]值提升25%，[绝意]值上限提升至125点。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze is increased by an additional 20%. When activating Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. Purge gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in Sniper Stance increases by 25%. Maximum Purge increases to 125.

cinema.name: 「以太视域」
cinema.description: 发动[追加攻击]时，「扳机」将获得1层[猎眸]；在[狙击姿态]下发动终结一击时，「扳机」将获得2层[猎眸]；每拥有1层[猎眸]，全队角色暴击伤害提升6%，最多叠加4层，持续10秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon using an Aftershock, Trigger gains 1 stack of Hunter's Gaze. When executing a Finishing Move in Sniper Stance, Trigger gains 2 stacks of Hunter's Gaze. Each stack of Hunter's Gaze increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 《归乡》
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 匿息隐踪
cinema.description: 「扳机」进入或延长[协战状态]后，状态持续期间，队伍中其他角色下一次触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]或[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]时，将会在招式命中敌人时触发[断离]效果，额外造成「扳机」200%攻击力的伤害，并累积「扳机」120%冲击力的失衡值；招式具有较高的打断等级。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Trigger enters or extends Coordinated Support, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot or Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus, it will trigger Disconnect upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.

cinema.name: 锁定的意志
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 冥河彼岸
cinema.nameEn: Beyond the River of the Dead
cinema.description: 进入战场时，「扳机」可获得5枚[破甲凶弹]，每消耗25点[绝意]值，「扳机」可额外获得1枚[破甲凶弹]，上限5枚；拥有[破甲凶弹]时，「扳机」在[狙击姿态]中命中目标时，将消耗1枚[破甲凶弹]，额外对目标造成「扳机」1200%攻击力的电属性伤害，且[破甲凶弹]造成的伤害额外提升50%，0.2秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 Armor Break Rounds. For every 25 Purge consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional Armor Break Round, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing Armor Break Rounds, when Trigger hits a target in Sniper Stance, 1 Armor Break Round is consumed to deal additional Electric DMG equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. Armor Break Round DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.

basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
「扳机」进入[狙击姿态]，向前方连续射击，造成电属性伤害；
连续射击期间，受到敌方攻击时，「扳机」将自动回避攻击，8秒内最多触发一次；
连续射击期间，可以拖曳摇杆，向左侧/右侧/后方调整身位；
自动回避攻击或在即将受到攻击时调整身位，将触发[极限闪避]，随后自动衔接发动蓄力反击；
松开 【普通攻击键】 后，「扳机」将后撤架枪并发动终结一击，随后退出[狙击姿态]；
蓄力反击和终结一击发动期间拥有无敌效果；
连续射击或蓄力反击命中敌人时，「扳机」将获得25点[绝意]值，[绝意]值上限100点；
终结一击命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，通过这种方式发动的[快速支援]25秒内最多触发一次。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Trigger enters the Sniper Stance and fires forward continuously, dealing Electric DMG.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the joystick to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a Perfect Dodge, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing [Basic Attack], Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit Sniper Stance.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 Purge, up to a maximum of 100 Purge.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. A Quick Assist can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：协奏狙杀
basic.description:
「扳机」拥有[绝意]值后，队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]、[特殊技]、[快速支援]命中敌人时触发：
围绕目标敌人，连续发动两次快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗3点[绝意]值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]为[追加攻击]；
全队3秒内最多触发1次[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, Dash Attack or Quick Assist to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot is an Aftershock attack.
The squad can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot once every 3s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱
basic.description:
「扳机」拥有[绝意]值后，队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动[强化特殊技]、[支援突击]、[终结技]重击命中敌人时触发：
围绕目标敌人，连续发动三次快速射击，随后发动终结一击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，消耗5点[绝意]值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]为[追加攻击]；
全队同一类型的招式，20秒内最多触发2次[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]；
[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]发动期间，触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀·冥狱]会直接发动。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, or Ultimate to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus is an Aftershock attack.
The same skill type can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus will immediately activate instead if triggered.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：怨魂返
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速举枪射击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：幽闪
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动突进斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：幽闪花葬
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动突进斩击，并在跃起后向地面追加一段强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式命中敌人时，「扳机」将进入[协战状态]，期间队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，即可触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]，无需消耗[绝意]值，且没有冷却时间的限制，持续8秒，可触发4次，重复进入[协战状态]时延长持续时间，并获得可触发次数；最多持续20秒，可触发10次。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

ultimate.name: 终结技：冥府挽歌
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力射击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式命中敌人时，「扳机」将进入[协战状态]，期间队伍中其他操作中的角色，发动任意攻击命中敌人时，即可触发[普通攻击：协奏狙杀]，无需消耗[绝意]值，且没有冷却时间的限制，持续12秒，可触发6次，重复进入[协战状态]时延长持续时间，并获得可触发次数；最多持续20秒，可触发10次。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：冷枪援护
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
转身回旋并对前方敌人发动快速射击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
